title: Harimau Malaya Drawn in Group A for Inaugural 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup Division 1
summary: Malaysia will face hosts Indonesia, Singapore, and Bangladesh in Division 1 of the new FIFA-sanctioned Southeast Asian tournament.
content: Malaysia has been drawn into Group A of Division 1 for the inaugural 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup in Indonesia. Sanctioned directly by FIFA following the MoU signed at the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur, the tournament will be held during an official FIFA international window from September 24 to October 5, 2026. Under interim head coach Tan Cheng Hoe, Harimau Malaya will kick off their campaign against Bangladesh at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta on September 25.

title: Tan Cheng Hoe Names 23-Man Harimau Malaya Squad for Division 1 Action in Jakarta
summary: Dion Cools leads a strong Malaysian squad featuring Arif Aiman, Faisal Halim, and Romel Morales.
content: Malaysia interim head coach Tan Cheng Hoe has announced his final 23-player squad traveling to Jakarta for Division 1 of the 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup. Captain Dion Cools anchors the defense alongside Dominic Tan, while Johor Darul Ta'zim superstar Arif Aiman Hanapi and Faisal Halim lead a formidable attacking lineup. 'Playing inside Gelora Bung Karno will test our resilience, but our target is reaching the Division 1 final,' Hoe declared.

title: Gelora Bung Karno & Si Jalak Harupat Ready for FIFA ASEAN Cup Division 1 Thrills
summary: Indonesia prepares world-class venues in Jakarta and Bandung as Division 1 host.
content: The Indonesian Football Association (PSSI) and FIFA match commissioners have confirmed that the 77,000-capacity Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta and the 30,000-capacity Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung are in peak condition for Division 1. Group A features Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Bangladesh, while Group B includes Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, and Australia.
